name: Sales
meaning: Quotations, orders, invoices and sales corrections (ADR-0047).

name: Purchasing
meaning: Requests, orders, supplier documents and customs (ADR-0047; ADR-0021).

name: Inventory
meaning: Stock documents, warehouse tasks and reservations (ADR-0020; ADR-0023; ADR-0027 rule 7).

name: Production
meaning: Production orders, issues, confirmations, receipts and subcontracting (ADR-0034; ADR-0037).

name: Planning
meaning: Planning runs, planned orders and forecasts (ADR-0024; ADR-0036).

name: Finance
meaning: Journal, periods, closing, currency, tax and costing (ADR-0011; ADR-0012; ADR-0014; ADR-0041).

name: Banking
meaning: Cash and bank documents, statements, money accounts and collections (ADR-0048).

name: Master data
meaning: Partners, products, prices, warehouses, organization and production structures (ADR-0045).

name: CRM
meaning: Interactions, complaints, outbound messages, mailboxes, data protection and partner insights (ADR-0052).

name: Administration
meaning: Users, roles, delegations, segregation, policy, settings, agents, work queue, audit and data (ADR-0054).

name: Reports
meaning: Report queries that total over documents, registered is_owner_scoped false (ADR-0054 rule 15; DS-26).

name: Sales invoice
meaning: ADR-0047; whether it may wait for approval follows the regime setting documents.issuance_without_delay (ADR-0053 rule 8).

name: GR/IR rounding clearing
meaning: ADR-0056 rule 10; posted only by the system as a consequence posting (is_internal_only); level full; in no template's expansion.

name: Warehouse tasks
meaning: Putaway, picking and status tasks, handling units (ADR-0023).

name: Planned orders
meaning: Firm, update and convert planned orders (ADR-0024; ADR-0036 rule 12).

name: Supplier items
meaning: CreateSupplierItem and UpdateSupplierItem at edit: supplier minimums, multiples, preference and lead times, the planning agent's lead-time proposals (ADR-0024 rules 2, 23).

name: Account opening balance
meaning: ADR-0044 rule 7; AcceptMigrationDifference at full (ADR-0044 rule 11; ADR-0054 rule 24).

name: Posting periods
meaning: Fiscal years and periods; Restrict and Open need post, Lock and Unlock full; capability post_in_soft_locked_period is full (ADR-0012; ADR-0054 rule 8).

name: Close checklist
meaning: Close tasks and their jobs (ADR-0012 rule 13).

name: Exchange rates
meaning: Rate sources and manual rates; CreateExchangeRate needs edit (ADR-0011; ADR-0054 rule 24).

name: Chart and determination
meaning: Accounts, account determination and subledger activation (ADR-0010; ADR-0015; ADR-0025).

name: Tax setup
meaning: Tax codes and the tax matrix (ADR-0041).

name: Regime options
meaning: Company choices among a regime's options; full (ADR-0016; ADR-0054 rule 24).

name: Bank statements and matching
meaning: Statement import, matching and matching rules (ADR-0048 rules 8-9).

name: Partners
meaning: Partners, roles, profiles, addresses, contacts and partner item codes (ADR-0019; ADR-0045).

name: Partner bank accounts
meaning: Changed only through change proposals (ADR-0029 rule 4); segregation rule bank_account_vs_payment.

name: Products and items
meaning: Products, items, variants, barcodes, classifications; GetItemUnits reads units here, and unit maintenance is on product_unit below (ADR-0018; ADR-0045; ADR-0056 rule 20 note).

name: Product units
meaning: CreateProductUom, UpdateProductUom, CreateUom and UpdateUom at edit: product and item units, their conversions and packaging, and company units; the aliases are on uom_alias below (ADR-0056 rules 4, 5, 15, 20).

name: Unit aliases
meaning: CreateUomAlias and UpdateUomAlias at edit: unit texts of partners and old systems, the purchase invoice agent's alias proposals included (ADR-0056 rules 19, 20).

name: Warehouses and bins
meaning: Warehouses, zones, bins, lots and serials (ADR-0023; ADR-0045).

name: Organization
meaning: Branches, cost centers, projects, working calendars, departments and teams (ADR-0045); the department, team and UpdateEmployeeOrganization commands need full (ADR-0054 rule 6).

name: Groups
meaning: Partner, tax, item and valuation groups and product categories (ADR-0045 rule 12).

name: Print profiles
meaning: Company and branch print profiles, seals and signatures; none in every template except owner (ADR-0049 rule 26; ADR-0054 rule 11).

name: Production structures
meaning: Bills of materials, routings, work centers, production versions and settings (ADR-0033).

name: Interactions
meaning: Interactions, participants, links, matching, partner e-mail domains, summaries, inbound messages and the partner timeline (ADR-0052 rules 5-10, 13, 18, 31).

name: Complaints
meaning: Complaints; Close and Reopen need post (ADR-0052 rule 20).

name: Outbound message
meaning: ADR-0052 rules 27-28; Send needs post; the sender job records the outcome with an is_internal_only command (ADR-0054 rule 8).

name: Mailboxes
meaning: Mailboxes, the authentication probe and the intake; RunMailboxIntake at full; the probe's and the intake's Record commands are is_internal_only (ADR-0052 rules 11-14; ADR-0054 rule 8).

name: Data protection
meaning: Processing purposes and bases; EraseDataSubject at full (ADR-0052 rules 22-25).

name: Partner insights
meaning: Insights, the duplicate scan and tax lookups; the jobs' commands are is_internal_only (ADR-0052 rules 17, 31; ADR-0054 rule 8).

name: General access
meaning: Commands and queries checked against their subject's or query's own permission and scope: ListAllowedCommand, printing, GetApprovalProgress and EvaluateBarcode at read, CreateAttachment and CreateListExport at edit; every template except auditor at edit (ADR-0040 rule 8; ADR-0054 rule 24).

name: Work queue
meaning: ListWorkItem, GetWorkItem, ClaimWorkItem, UnclaimWorkItem, ResolveWorkItem, CreateWorkItemNote (ADR-0042).

name: Work queue administration
meaning: AssignWorkItem, CancelWorkItem and capability list_all_work_items at full (ADR-0042 rules 10, 12).

name: Delegations
meaning: ADR-0054 rule 21; capability delegate_for_others at full.

name: Segregation of duties
meaning: Segregation rules, conflicts, exceptions, reviews and the small-company mode (ADR-0054 rules 17-20).

name: Policy and approval
meaning: Policy rules, approval procedures and approval pools, policy decisions, ConfirmAutoPost at post (the rule's owner only) and ClearTaint at full; RunApprovalEscalation is is_internal_only (ADR-0043; ADR-0055; ADR-0029 rules 8, 13; ADR-0054 rule 24).

name: Company settings
meaning: Company settings and numbering configuration (ADR-0009 rule 15).

name: Agents
meaning: Agent type settings (UpdateAgentTypeSetting at full), promotion evidence, agent run queries, capability cancel_agent_runs at full, schedules and intakes; start_agent:<agent_type> is on each agent type's own leaf below (ADR-0050 rules 14-20; ADR-0054 rule 24).

name: Customer onboarding agent
meaning: Capability start_agent:customer_onboarding at edit (ADR-0051; ADR-0054 rule 24).

name: Quotation agent
meaning: Capability start_agent:quotation at edit (ADR-0051; ADR-0054 rule 24).

name: Bank matching agent
meaning: Capability start_agent:bank_matching at edit (ADR-0051; ADR-0054 rule 24).

name: Purchase invoice agent
meaning: Capability start_agent:purchase_invoice at edit (ADR-0051; ADR-0054 rule 24).

name: Planning agent
meaning: Capability start_agent:planning at edit (ADR-0051; ADR-0054 rule 24).

name: Data migration agent
meaning: Capability start_agent:data_migration at edit (ADR-0051; ADR-0054 rule 24).

name: Document reader agent
meaning: Capability start_agent:document_reader at edit (ADR-0057 rule 31; ADR-0054 rule 24).

name: Product engineering agent
meaning: Capability start_agent:product_engineering at edit (ADR-0062 rule 1; ADR-0054 rule 24).

name: Agent run bodies
meaning: Capability read_agent_run_bodies at full; none in every template except owner (ADR-0050 rule 20; ADR-0054 rule 8).

name: Event deliveries
meaning: RetryEventDelivery and SkipEventDelivery at post, ReplayEvents at full, all human_only, for deliveries with a company; installation deliveries stay with the operator (ADR-0013 rules 8, 16; ADR-0054 rule 24).

name: Print templates
meaning: Print templates and print data contracts, no document data; GetPrintData is on general_access with the subject's own check; the render worker's outcome is is_internal_only (ADR-0049 rules 20, 24-25; ADR-0054 rule 8).

name: Financial reports
meaning: Financial statements, books and the cash book (DS-26); FileStatutoryReport at post (ADR-0049 rule 19).

name: Tax reports
meaning: Tax returns and listings (DS-26; ADR-0041); FileTaxReturn at post (ADR-0041 rule 18).

name: Production cost settlement
meaning: ADR-0035 rules 1, 5; written only by the period-end costing job.

name: Configuration
meaning: Automation rules, decision tables and parameter sets: drafts at edit; ConfirmAutomationRuleOwnership by the named owner; SetArtifactVersionState, SetArtifactCurrentVersion, DisableAutomationRule and EnableAutomationRule at full; RecordGoldenCaseLabel needs the approve flag on the labelled function's own leaf (ADR-0058 rules 27-28; ADR-0059 rules 13, 22).

name: Automation evidence
meaning: Automation executions and replays at read, filtered by the reader's scope and classes; CreateArtifactEvidence at full; artifact evidence, transitions and monitor snapshots at read (ADR-0058 rules 11, 27; ADR-0059 rule 27).

name: Analysis questions
meaning: CreateAnalysisQuestion (human_only), UpdateAnalysisFeedback and UpdateAnalysisAnswer (for the human an analysis run acts for) at edit; ListAnalysisQuestion and GetAnalysisQuestion at read, own questions only (ADR-0060 rules 14, 21).

name: Saved analyses
meaning: ListAnalysisExample at read; capability share_saved_analysis (company-wide saved analyses and KPIs), CreateAnalysisExample and UpdateAnalysisExample at edit; ReleaseSavedAnalysis and ReleaseAnalysisExample at post; private saved analyses and running them are on general_access (ADR-0060 rules 14, 26, 28).

name: Analysis debug
meaning: Capability read_analysis_debug at full: other people's stored analysis answers and the planner's raw cost estimates; none in every template except owner (ADR-0060 rules 14, 21).

name: Analysis agent
meaning: Capability start_agent:analysis at edit (ADR-0060 rule 20; ADR-0054 rule 24).

name: Data processing
meaning: Data-processing permissions of the company: SetDataProcessingPermission through an approved proposal and EndDataProcessingPermission at full; the provider check job (ADR-0063 rule 14; ADR-0057 rule 20).
